target.title: fix(sessions): auto-generate session titles via AI summarization
target.body:
Closes #77165
Related #89705

## What Problem This Solves

Users with many saved sessions only had manual names, first-message fallbacks, or session-id fallbacks, so session history was hard to scan and search.

This PR adds an opt-in path that stores a durable `autoTitle` once enough direct user turns exist, while keeping manual labels/display names/origin labels/subjects higher priority.

The intended result is that enabled sessions can show and search concise stored titles in the gateway and Control UI, without changing default behavior or requiring a migration/backfill.

Out of scope: manual rename UI, migration/backfill for existing sessions, default-enabling generated titles, provider/channel/plugin capability changes, agent-facing `sessions_list` behavior, ConfigIO typing, generic session-store merge policy, and test-project routing.

## Why This Change Was Made

The feature is implemented as a default-off `sessionTitle` config surface plus additive `autoTitle` session metadata. The background title task reads only direct user text from the transcript head, skips heartbeat, internal-system, and inter-session/tool-mediated provenance, ignores textless/media-only records, caps each message and the total model input, and writes only if the persisted `sessionId` still matches.

The title lifecycle is kept at the session metadata source of truth: `autoTitle` is created once after a successful reply, persisted without refreshing `updatedAt`, cleared on reset/new/rollover, and projected to gateway and Control UI consumers. This avoids recomputing titles in display fallbacks and avoids making an older session look newly active when a delayed title write lands later.

Manual title sources remain authoritative, and the feature stays opt-in/default-off. The remaining product/privacy/auth-profile routing decisions are maintainer-owned because enabled sessions send bounded transcript excerpts to the selected title model.

## User Impact

When `sessionTitle.enabled` is true, users with many saved sessions can identify conversations by concise stored titles instead of first-message snippets or ids.

Default-off behavior is unchanged. Existing manual names still win over generated titles, reset/rollover clears generated metadata without removing manual names, and late background title writes do not reorder sessions by refreshing activity timestamps.

## Evidence

- **Fix classification:** Root-cause feature completion for opt-in model-created session titles.
- **Maintainer-ready confidence:** High for the scoped code update after focused validation and final review; maintainer product/privacy/auth acceptance and any reviewer-requested live UI or gateway proof remain maintainer-owned before merge.
- **Root cause:** Saved sessions had no durable generated-title source of truth, so session lists fell back to manual names, first user message snippets, or session ids.
- **Why this is root-cause fix:** `autoTitle` is created once in the reply lifecycle, stored on the session entry, preserved without refreshing session activity, cleared with reset/rollover state, and projected to gateway/Control UI instead of being recomputed by display fallbacks.
- **Patch quality notes:** The broad catches are intentional isolation for a non-blocking background title task; failures log or no-op instead of interrupting the user reply. The `null`/`false` returns are explicit skip/no-title states for invalid, absent, stale, manually titled, or unreadable sessions.
- **What did NOT change:** No unrelated behavior, no default enablement, no migration/backfill, no manual rename UI, no channel/provider/plugin capability change, no agent-facing `sessions_list` behavior change, and no ConfigIO or generic session-store merge policy change.
- **Architecture / source-of-truth check:** `autoTitle` is persisted as session metadata and projected outward; gateway and UI do not maintain a second title source. Runtime auth selection for this path is kept behind internal runtime code so the public runtime-auth helper contract is not expanded.
- **Related open PR / same-contract scan:** Related context is tracked in #89705. This update is scoped to the existing PR branch for #77165 and does not open a competing new PR or broaden the public provider-auth helper contract.
- **Target test file:** `src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts`, `src/gateway/session-utils.test.ts`, `src/gateway/server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts`, and focused Control UI session tests.
- **Scenario locked in:** Enabled sessions with enough direct user turns get one bounded stored title; manual titles and stale async writes prevent overwrite; reset/new/rollover clears generated titles while preserving manual display names and session activity ordering.
- **Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail:** The feature spans title creation, persistence, reset/rollover cleanup, gateway projection, and UI projection; the final diff removes earlier nonessential `sessions_list`, ConfigIO, generic store merge, test-routing, and public helper expansion work.
- **Risk labels considered:** compatibility, session-state, public config/schema, auth-provider routing, availability, privacy/cost boundary.
- **Risk explanation:** The highest-risk area is sending bounded transcript excerpts to the title model when the feature is explicitly enabled.
- **Why acceptable:** The feature is opt-in/default-off, filters non-direct, internal-system, and non-text user records, caps input size, skips manual-title sessions, guards stale writes by `sessionId`, writes `autoTitle` without refreshing `updatedAt`, and runs after reply delivery.

Validation run through the daily-fix wrapper in the task worktree:

- `pnpm exec vitest --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts --run` — passed 13/13 title-generator tests for the current update, including preserve-activity writes and internal-system provenance filtering.
- `pnpm exec vitest --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session-title-generator.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/conversation-label-generator.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/get-reply-run.media-only.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts --run` — passed 4 test files / 233 tests for the scoped title path before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `pnpm exec vitest --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts src/gateway/session-utils.test.ts src/gateway/server.sessions.list-changed.test.ts --run` — passed 4 test files / 366 tests before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `pnpm exec vitest --config test/vitest/vitest.ui.config.ts ui/src/ui/controllers/sessions.test.ts ui/src/ui/views/sessions.test.ts --run` — passed 2 test files / 109 tests before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `pnpm exec vitest --config test/vitest/vitest.plugins.config.ts src/plugins/runtime/runtime-model-auth.runtime.test.ts --run` — passed 1 test file / 5 tests before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `pnpm run plugin-sdk:api:check` — passed before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `pnpm run config:docs:check` — passed before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `pnpm run plugin-sdk:surface:check` — passed with 0 package-exported forbidden subpaths before the latest preserve-activity patch.
- `git diff --check` — passed before the latest preserve-activity patch and is rerun before submit.

Coverage includes config opt-in, runtime model/auth forwarding, transcript filtering, input caps, manual title precedence, stale async write skip, post-reply metadata notification, activity timestamp preservation for generated-title writes, reset/rollover cleanup, gateway row/search/event behavior, and Control UI event patch/filter/display behavior.

Review state:

- The latest `updatedAt` finding is addressed by using the preserve-activity session patch path, with focused regression coverage in `session-title-generator.test.ts`.
- The public runtime-auth helper expansion was removed; remaining session auth-profile routing is disclosed as maintainer-owned.
- The product/privacy/cost boundary is disclosed: this is opt-in/default-off, bounded, manual-title preserving, and non-blocking.
- Full live browser/Control UI proof and live gateway proof were not captured locally; this remains a disclosed proof limitation rather than a hidden code claim.
- Remote CI and maintainer review are still pending after submit.
